lines: IMA's growth trajectory since 2020 is among the most aggressive in the independent broker category. The combination of $3.25B in PE capital and an employee-ownership culture has produced a rare dual-engine growth model: acquisition pace of a PE-backed firm with the retention economics of an employee-owned firm. The 40%+ annual workforce CAGR directly drives the need for the FSC unification platform. [E-088, E-001, E-096]

IMA is a private company with no publicly available audited financials. All figures are derived from press releases, PE profiles, industry rankings, and analyst estimates. Trend: ACCELERATING — 3+ consecutive years of above-industry premium growth with no confirmed slowdown. [E-088, E-001, E-096]

5-Year CAGR (2020-2025): Revenue ~40%+ | Workforce ~40%+ | States 7 to 23+ (~27% CAGR). Data basis: press releases + PE profiles (private company — no audited financials). [E-088, E-001, IMA Feb 2025 press release]
